name: unicorn-mining-co
description: A web game created for Js13kGames
author: burntcustard

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: npm run catalog:go && GOEXPERIMENT=simd go build -o bin/server ./src/server
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/test.mjs && npm run test:go
scripts.test:go: npm run catalog:go && node --import tsx tests/parity/generate-fixtures.ts && GOEXPERIMENT=simd go test ./src/server/... && node --import tsx tests/parity/snapshot.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/parity/session.test.ts
scripts.test:go:physics: npm run catalog:go && node --import tsx tests/parity/generate-fixtures.ts && go test ./src/server/collision/... ./src/server/physics/...
scripts.test:packets: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/parity/snapshot.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/integration/server-integration.test.ts
scripts.test:server: npm run catalog:go && GOEXPERIMENT=simd go test ./src/server/network
